title: Astral Fabrication: deploy hypotheses & call notes
content:
Call notes (2025-02-13):
- Attendees: Priya (RW), Ethan (RW), Jonah (Astral infra), Mei (Astral ML eng), Sam (Astral SRE)
- Quick ask: run a private deployment behind their Azure VNet with KMS-backed key management and strict egress controls. Target: 95th pctile < 220ms for 512-token requests, throughput ~120 reqs/min typical, burst to 500/min.
- Primary model: LlamaX-13B-quant (customer preference for open weights); fallback plan to LlamaX-7B-int8 if memory/throughput constraints.

Requirements captured (rough):
- Network: VNet peering + service endpoint, allowlist only, no public egress except to RW control plane endpoints. Must pass security review (Confluence-1234).
- Keys: customer uses Azure Key Vault HSM; need to confirm we can integrate via customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own) or use RW proxy encryption.
- Data residency: logs aggregated to their workspace in EU-West; request: redact PII from debug traces automatically (need to propose a config).
- Capacity: initial reserved GPUs: 4x A100-40GB (est) with autoscale to 8 for bursts; ask: can RW suggest cheaper quantized profile to reduce to 2x?
- Observability: they want token-level latency heatmap + per-route cost breakdown forwarded to their Splunk instance.

Deployment hypotheses (brainstorm):
1) Full private (control plane isolated in RW-managed VPC) + compute in customer subnet: best for security, more plumbing. Pros: straightforward KMS integration, keeps model weights in controlled network. Cons: longer lead time (3-4 weeks), SRE involvement from Astral.
2) Hybrid: RW control plane hosted, compute in RW Dedicated but with VPN to Astral VNet and strict firewall rules. Pros: faster, easier ops. Cons: customer may object to compute outside their VNet for compliance.
3) On-prem packaged appliance (VM image + containerized runtime) shipped to Astral datacenter. Pros: meets highest compliance. Cons: heavy ops, limited visibility, support complexity.

Technical gotchas & unknowns (need answers):
- KMS: can we proxy Azure KV tokens or must customer create RW service principal? (ACTION: Ethan to confirm with infra team; ref: JIRA-ASTRAL-18)
- Model pinning: LlamaX-13B quant has 48GB VRAM requirement at 4-bit quant + KV cache; their beam size often spikes to 3. Need confirmation on token-length distribution to size KV cache. (ACTION: ask Mei for sample traces)
- Batching policy: customer expects low latency; default RW batching will add jitter. Hypothesis: use small continuous batching window (5ms) + strict max batch size 8. (Note to self: benchmark with 5, 10, 20ms windows)
- Fallback routing: if Dedicated pool full, route to smaller model with heuristic based on prompt length. Need to prototype fallback config in sandbox.
- Network egress: Observability requires logs to their Splunk; discuss SFTP/secure-forwarder option if direct egress prohibited.

Security/Compliance notes:
- They require SOC2-type artifact for any RW access to logs. Provide narrow IAM roles, WFH: temporary keys rotation every 24h for our engineers.
- Audit log retention: 12 months. Need to form retention plan and show Confluence page.

Immediate next steps (owner / ETA):
- Ethan: verify KMS integration patterns and write small spec (2d) -> link to PR terraform-astral/pull/42.
- Priya: produce short options memo comparing Full private vs Hybrid (1d) and share with Mei & Jonah.
- Mei (Astral): extract 48 hours of token-length distribution and representative payloads (3d).
- Lena: run micro-benchmarks on LlamaX-13B-quant w/ batching windows 5/10/20ms and report median & p95 latencies (4d).
- Omar: draft Splunk forwarder options and compliance checklist (2d).
- Schedule: follow-up technical deep-dive w/ Astral infra + RW infra next Tue 2025-02-18 10:00 PT.

Open questions for next call (priority order):
1) KMS exact flow and who holds rotation keys.
2) Are we allowed to place compute in their VNet (yes/no)? If no, what are the exact compliance blockers?
3) Which Prometheus/Splunk endpoints are writable from RW infra?
4) Agreement on fallback models and SLOs for degraded mode (document as appendix).

Notes to self:
- Keep language concrete in customer docs; they respond badly to fuzzy timelines.
- Prepare a single-page tradeoff chart (latency vs cost vs isolation) for the next meeting.
- Add a short demo notebook showing quantized-LlamaX 13B perf on A100 vs T4 to support cost recommendation.

Misc scraps / raw ideas:
- Consider offering a short pilot: 2-week proof-of-performance with 2 GPUs and an SLA-lite for smoke test. Price as fixed monthly + overage.
- Could prototype a log-redaction lambda that strips email/SSNs before forwarding to Splunk.

End of note.
